title: Marina suspends safety permit of vessel grounded in Surigao City

blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY — The Maritime Industry Authority (Marina) has immediately suspended the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate (PSSC) of MV Georgia 1 after the vessel ran aground at the Port of Surigao in Surigao City early Thursday. In a statement, Marina said the suspension was done in keeping with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon’s directive to ensure safe and reliable sea transport services. Operated by San Ricardo Shipping Lines Corp., MV Georgia 1 departed from San Ricardo, Southern Leyte, and arrived at the Port of Surigao around 4 a.m. on Thursday.
